inputs.name: hand over from CI/CD Pipeline to Canary and A/B Testing

output.level_0: The pipeline crashes before the canary step, leaving the old model serving stale forecasts.
output.level_1: No canary testing exists, so new models deploy to all stores without preliminary validation.
output.level_2: Buyers manually compare test and control store availability to decide if a new model is safe.
output.level_3: The system automatically splits traffic and halts deployment if the new model underperforms the baseline.
output.level_4: Governed canary tests verify compliance with loyalty data rules before promoting the model to production.
